import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool as tool
ATTACHMENTS_ROOT = Path('/var/support/attachments')
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path('/var/support/archive')
RETENTION_POLICY_FILE = Path('/var/support/config/retention_policy.json')

def _move_attachment_folder(ticket_id: int) -> Path:
    source_folder = ATTACHMENTS_ROOT / str(ticket_id)
    if not source_folder.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'No attachments for ticket {ticket_id}')
    ARCHIVE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_folder = ARCHIVE_ROOT / str(ticket_id)
    shutil.move(str(source_folder), str(destination_folder))
    return destination_folder

@tool
def archive_and_run_ticket_export(ticket_id: int) -> str:
    # Read the retention policy and count attachments before moving
    retention_policy = ''
    if RETENTION_POLICY_FILE.is_file():
        retention_policy = RETENTION_POLICY_FILE.read_text()
    attachment_count = sum(1 for p in (ATTACHMENTS_ROOT / str(ticket_id)).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    print(f'Ticket {ticket_id}: {attachment_count} attachment files, policy loaded={bool(retention_policy)}')
    destination_folder = _move_attachment_folder(ticket_id)
    completed = subprocess.run(['/opt/support/bin/build_archive_bundle', '--ticket', str(ticket_id), '--dir', str(destination_folder)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return f'Export failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}'
    return f'Archived ticket {ticket_id}: {completed.stdout.strip()}'
